notes:
Pass on the fake backend (gate exit 0; G1-G9 all pass, no warnings). Evidence is contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. Model-authored by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 (run wC-087) and unreviewed; reviewed_by is null; nothing ran on hardware and no hardware was attached.

SHAPE: the card's family-config/SerialDriver decision was confirmed. The upstream clone is a flat pyserial module (README.md:5), not a class: ask_device and set_device each open /dev/ttyUSB0 at 9600 8N1 and send newline-terminated text (SR830.py:11-29). The command words all occur in the clone, so the serial bridge command table expresses the wire syntax and the bridge opens pyserial itself; the clone is never imported or run. native is set to SR830:ask_device (the first card entry symbol; both were confirmed at SR830.py:11 and 22). A SerialDriver holds one native symbol; the write entry point SR830:set_device is the same transport and is not imported by this package. No DEVIATION FROM THE CARD.

COVERED: reads x (OUTP? 1), y (OUTP? 2), r (OUTP? 3), theta (OUTP? 4), phase (PHAS?), frequency (FREQ?), amplitude (SLVL?), input_config (ISRC?), ground (IGND?), coupling (ICPL?), line_filter (ILIN?), reserve (RMOD?), time_constant_index (OFLT?), slope (OFSL?), sync (SYNC?) and identity (*IDN?). Writes frequency (FREQ), amplitude (SLVL), input_config (ISRC), ground (IGND), coupling (ICPL), line_filter (ILIN), reserve (RMOD), time_constant_index (OFLT), slope (OFSL) and sync (SYNC). Every write has response=False because the clone's set_device reads no reply (SR830.py:22-29). The e-stop writes SLVL 0.004, the lowest value set_ampl accepts (SR830.py:202-204); it is a software stop at R1, not an independent hardware e-stop, and none is claimed.

LIMITS: frequency 0.001..102000 Hz (SR830.py:185); amplitude 0.004..5.0 (SR830.py:203); input_config 0..3 (SR830.py:211); ground 0/1 (215); coupling 0/1 (219); line_filter 0..3 (223); reserve 0..2 (260); time_constant_index 0..19 (267-286); slope 0..2 (291); sync 0/1 (295). No operator-required limits, so no site-limits.example.json is included. The clone names no unit for amplitude, phase, theta, X, Y or R; amplitude and the integer indexes carry the dimensionless UCUM unit 1 and the descriptions say the clone does not name a physical unit. Frequency is Hz because set_freq states it (SR830.py:187).

NOT COVERED: (1) The upstream set_phas is broken: it sends FREQ instead of PHAS (SR830.py:165-167), so phase is a read only and there is no phase write. (2) set_aux_inp is broken: it uses ++ and raises TypeError (SR830.py:319-322), so the AUXV auxiliary input is not exposed. (3) OUTR?, SNAP?, SPTS?, the data-storage commands (SRAT, SEND, TSTR, TRIG, STRT, PAUS, REST), the display/output settings (DDEF, FPOP, OEXP, OUTX, KCLK, OVRM), save/recall (SSET, RSET), *RST, the auto functions (AGAN, ARSV, APHS, AOFF), the harmonic (HARM), the sensitivity table (SENS), the reference source (FMOD) and the sample-rate/trigger modes are not exposed. (4) The frequency write is sent regardless of the reference source; the upstream set_freq only writes when FMOD? is 1 (SR830.py:183-192), which a config-only SerialDriver cannot check. (5) The time constant is exposed as the clone's OFLT index, not as seconds, because the read returns the index and no table decode is in the read path.

FAKE: the card's preferred transcript was not available (no upstream simulator, recording or tests; mock_strategy.hints is empty). fake.py is an in-memory pyserial-like transport that answers only the command words the driver sends and keeps the settings, so a write changes the answer of its own query. Every number and the identity string are placeholder test data, marked # placeholder. It does not import or run the clone. G7 transport mode checks the command mnemonics against the clone, not the fake class.

SAFETY: risk R1, above the card's R0 floor. The loader refuses the hardware backend of an unreviewed model-written package only at R2 and R3, so this R1 package is not protected by that rule; use its hardware backend only with a person at the device. The serial line defaults are the clone's /dev/ttyUSB0, 9600, 8N1, 0.1 s timeout (SR830.py:13); a deployment may override the port. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run; gate.digest is the digest line the last check printed.
